exposure: premature rupture of membranes at term
induction of labor with dinoprostone intracervical gel
cohort: 101 women with premature rupture of membranes (PROM) at term and unfavorable cervix, undergoing induction of labor (IOL) with dinoprostone intracervical gel
finding: Cervical length was significantly shorter in vaginal deliveries compared to cesarean deliveries, regardless of parity.
mod_finding: Cut-off values of cervical length for predicting cesarean section were 37.5 mm in nulliparae and 34.5 mm in multiparae.
